claims.claim: Selling a Janome Memory Craft 6500 computerized sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0: brand 'JANOME' and model 'Memory Craft 6500' are clearly visible on the machine.
Photo 0 shows visible wear and scuff marks on the front base; internal components, functionality, and full condition cannot be assessed from this single photo.
Subjective claim; cannot be verified from photos alone without testing or expert assessment.

risks.risk: Machine may not be functional or may have internal mechanical/electrical faults
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the machine powered on, needle moving, and stitch operation in progress.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or wear to internal components (e.g., motor, feed dogs, bobbin system)
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bobbin area, feed dogs, and motor housing, or a video of the machine operating.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (e.g., foot pedal, power cord, instruction manual, presser feet)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the machine.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Close-up photos of the bobbin area, feed dogs, and motor housing.
Photo showing all included accessories (foot pedal, power cord, manuals, etc.).
Photo of the machine from the back and underside to check for damage or wear.
response.reason: The model and brand are clearly identifiable, but the condition and functionality cannot be confirmed from a single photo. Visible wear suggests potential use, but internal functionality, completeness, and hidden damage are unknown. Proof of operation and accessories is needed before pricing.
